---- 
For the Petitioner : Mr. Ritesh Kr. Jaiswal, Adv.

For the State : Mr. Suraj Deo Munda, A.P.P.
 ----
 th  02/Dated: 05 June, 2025 1.
Heard learned counsel for the petitioner and learned counsel for the State.

2. The petitioner who is in custody since 22.02.2025 has approached this Court for grant of regular bail in connection with Basia P.S. Case No.51 of 2023, registered for the offences under Sections 420, 467, 468 and 471 of the Indian Penal Code, pending in the court of learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gumla.
3.
It has been submitted by the learned counsel for the petitiner that the petitioner has falsely been implicated in this case.
Further, there is no criminal antecedent against him and he is ready to abide by every condition imposed as by this Court.
On the above basis, prayer for bail has been made.
4. Learned counsel for the State has opposed the prayer for bail.
5. Considering the fact that there is no criminal antecedent, I am inclined to enlarge the petitioner on bail.

Accordingly, the petitioner, named above, is directed to be released on bail, on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/- (Rupees Twenty Thousand Only) with two sureties of the like amount each Bablu Sahu vs The State Of Jharkhand .... .... ... on 5 June, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/101391803/
1 to the satisfaction of the learned Additional Chief Judicial Magistrate, Gumla in connection with Basia P.S. Case No.51 of 2023.
6.

(Deepak Roshan, J.) Amar/-
